name: Zaskaleta Talking Profile v2
goal: Make speech appear physically produced by the visible speaker instead of layered over the video.

speech_motion_targets.jaw: clear but not exaggerated articulation synchronized to voiced phonemes
speech_motion_targets.cheeks: subtle cheek displacement coupled to mouth opening and consonant articulation
speech_motion_targets.mouth: stable mouth identity, natural closure at pauses, no rubber-mouth effect
speech_motion_targets.eyes: natural fixation with occasional blink and micro-saccade behavior
speech_motion_targets.blink: avoid repetitive blinking; prefer natural blink timing near phrase boundaries
speech_motion_targets.head: retain real reference micro-motion; do not synthesize artificial head sway
speech_motion_targets.pause_expression: mouth relaxes and jaw closes during pauses
speech_motion_targets.sentence_end: subtle facial relaxation after final syllables
speech_motion_targets.breathing: retain real breathing rhythm from approved behavior reference
speech_motion_targets.shoulders: retain real shoulder and neck motion from approved behavior reference

must_pass: voice sounds attached to the visible speaker
